cells.reason: Passage states Morgan Stanley's positioning of its workplace/conversion efforts as singular and differentiated in the industry.

items.text: Morgan Stanley states it is now in a singular position in the industry because of the integrated scaling of its client acquisition funnel, including a differentiated workplace offering that continues to expand and source new relationships.
items.quote: We are now in a singular position in the industry where we see the integrated scaling of the funnel that you described... We have, as Sharon was describing, a differentiated workplace offering that continues to expand and source new relationships.

items.text: Morgan Stanley states that its investments in the workplace channel, including its collaboration with Carta and partnerships with Zero Hash, deepen its competitive moats and reinforce its leadership in the industry.
items.quote: In the third quarter, we continue to invest, deepening our competitive moats in areas like our expanded collaboration with Carta in private markets and in digital assets through announced partnerships with Zero Hash. We continue to innovate, reinforcing our leadership in the industry and enhancing our ability to service our clients with unique capabilities.

items.text: Morgan Stanley states that both net new assets of $356 billion and fee-based flows of $160 billion for the full year demonstrate industry-leading growth.
items.quote: Both net new assets of $356 billion and fee-based flows of $160 billion for the full year demonstrate industry-leading growth. Workplace and E-Trade relationships continue to seek out advice.

items.text: Morgan Stanley states it remains the industry leader with record net new assets of $148 billion and strong fee-based flows of $39 billion, underpinned by its client acquisition funnel.
items.quote: We remain the industry leader with record net new assets of $148 billion and strong fee-based flows of $39 billion.

items.text: Morgan Stanley states it has about 70% of the top 100 unicorns by market cap in terms of its workplace pipeline.
items.quote: we have about 70% of the top 100 unicorns by market cap in terms of our workplace pipeline.

items.text: Morgan Stanley states that since acquiring E*TRADE and expanding its workplace offering, it has added over $2 trillion of net new assets, demonstrating a differentiated client acquisition funnel and a powerful competitive advantage.
items.quote: Since acquiring E*TRADE and expanding our workplace offering 6 years ago, we have added over $2 trillion of net new assets. Our multiyear track record demonstrates our differentiated client acquisition funnel and its durability... Together, these strengths provide us with a powerful competitive advantage that positions us to lead as the future of wealth management takes shape.

items.text: Morgan Stanley states that its investments in self-directed and Workplace channels drive its differentiated client acquisition funnel.
items.quote: In Wealth Management, investments in our self-directed and Workplace channels drive our differentiated client acquisition funnel.

items.text: Morgan Stanley states that the workplace channel brings relationships and assets onto the platform and that these capabilities set the firm apart.
items.quote: illustrating the strength of the workplace channel as a strong contributor to the top of the funnel... We are investing from a position of strength and believe these capabilities set us apart.
